overview.topic: 🔎 선택 설계자로서의 알고리즘과 인간 주체성 보호

key_grammar.source_sentence: By curating what we see, what we are recommended, and what options are presented to us, they subtly, and sometimes not so subtly, nudge us towards particular paths.

explanation.text: 전치사 by 뒤에는 동사가 그대로 올 수 없고, 명사 역할을 하는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 해요.
전치사의 목적어 자리에는 명사·대명사·동명사만 올 수 있기 때문이에요.
by curating은 '~을 선별함으로써'라는 뜻으로 수단·방법을 나타내요.
by curate(X), by to curate(X)는 모두 틀리고 by curating(O)만 맞아요.

key_grammar.example_analysis: 전치사 by의 목적어로 동사 curate가 아니라 동명사 curating이 쓰였고, 그 동명사가 what절 세 개를 목적어로 취한다.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: By [[1|curate]] what we see, [[2|what]] we [[3|are recommended]], and what options [[4|are presented]] to us, they subtly, and sometimes not so subtly, [[5|nudge]] us towards particular paths.
drills.fix: 전치사 by의 목적어이므로 동사원형이 아닌 동명사가 와야 한다. curate → curating.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: While nudges [[can be used/can be use]] for beneficial purposes, such as [[encouraging/encourage]] healthier habits, they also carry the potential for manipulation, particularly when the underlying objectives of the architects [[are/is]] not aligned with the well-being or autonomy of the individual.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
drills.answer: It means actively seek out diverse perspectives, challenging algorithmic recommendations, and making deliberate choices that go against the predicted grain.
drills.fix: 동사 mean은 목적어로 동명사를 취하므로 seek → seeking.
options: Algorithms are, in essence, sophisticated architects of our digital environments.
The question then becomes: how can we cultivate and protect our human agency in an increasingly algorithmic world?
It means actively seek out diverse perspectives, challenging algorithmic recommendations, and making deliberate choices that go against the predicted grain.
It requires a conscious effort to maintain critical engagement with the technologies we use.
By curating what we see, what we are recommended, and what options are presented to us, they subtly, and sometimes not so subtly, nudge us towards particular paths.

drills.question: 그녀는 오래된 사진들을 정리함으로써 하루를 시작했다.
drills.answer: She started her day by organizing the old photos.

drills.question: 그것은 다양한 관점을 적극적으로 찾아 나서고, 알고리즘의 추천에 이의를 제기하며, 예측된 방향을 거스르는 신중한 선택을 하는 것을 의미한다.
drills.answer: It means actively seeking out diverse perspectives, challenging algorithmic recommendations, and making deliberate choices that go against the predicted grain.
